goal.insight: Visually contrast the shift from communicable-disease-dominated DALY burden in 1990 to chronic/NCD-dominated burden in 2024, making the structural transition immediately apparent

Highlight the stark differences in disease burden composition across World Bank income groups, showing that low-income countries retain a high communicable disease share while high-income countries are overwhelmingly NCD-dominated
Emphasize the rank changes of the top 10 DALY causes between 1990 and 2024, making large rank shifts (e.g., lower respiratory infections dropping, ischemic heart disease rising) visually prominent
Show the aggregate communicable vs NCD vs injury share of total DALYs for each income group in both years, so the viewer can compare proportions at a glance
Use color coding to consistently distinguish communicable diseases, non-communicable diseases, and injuries across all panels and datasets
